L128:   * Academic Evaluation and MyProgress Degree Planning
L129: Every applicant and enrolled student at TESU receives a personal evaluation of their transfer credit. A web-based degree planning tool, MyProgress, displays the transfer course information and allows you to plan courses that are still needed to complete the degree requirements. MyProgress shows your degree requirements by categories of credits needed, such as General Education, Area of Study, and Elective requirements.
L130: 
L131: MyProgress will:
L132:   * Show you where your previously earned credit (transfer, licenses/certifications) will fit into your degree
L133:   * Show you what courses you have left to take and allow you to search for all the TESU options to fill each requirement
L134:   * Provide you with an invaluable planning tool when talking with a TESU academic advisor
L135: 
L136:   * 【62†How do I send transcripts and other documentation to be evaluated?】
L137: All official transcripts and documentation of a student’s past college credits, professional and/or military training and other licenses/certifications, should be sent to:
L138: 
L139: The Office of the Registrar
L140: Thomas Edison State University
L141: 111 W. State St.
L142: Trenton, NJ 08608
L143: 
L144: Graduate students must submit an official transcript from the institution which awarded their baccalaureate degree.
L145: 
L146: Please visit 【63†Sending Transcripts】 for detailed information about sending documentation for evaluation.
L147:   * 【64†How do I know my documentation/transcript has been received?】
L148: 
L149: An email is sent to you each time we receive a transfer document. Students can check on the status of their documentation/transcripts by logging into Online Student Services. Under the header Transfer Credit Evaluated by TESU, you can see the transcripts we’ve received as well as how we have evaluated the credit.
L150: 
L151:   * 【65†How long does it take for my academic evaluation to be processed?】
L152: After acceptance, the academic evaluation process will usually be completed within 10 business days from the date your transcripts have been received. You will receive an email letting you know when your academic evaluation has been completed, as well as instructions on how you can view it online.
L153: 
L154:   * 【66†How do I access my academic evaluation?】
L155: Your academic evaluation information is used in MyProgress, a degree planning tool, to show you where your transfer credits have been applied to fulfill degree requirements. MyProgress is a function in our student services portal, 【67†Online Student Services】. If you need assistance with your login or password, please visit out 【67†Student Self Service informational page】.
L156: Applicants and newly admitted students are encouraged to 【68†schedule an appointment with academic advisor†tesu.itfrontdesk.com】 to review the information in MyProgress. Advisors will help explain how your transfer credits apply to your new degree and what courses and requirements you need to complete to finish your degree.
L157: 
L158:   * 【69†When can I register for courses?】
L159: Applicants who have been accepted to Thomas Edison State University may enroll and register for courses immediately. However, it is helpful to wait until after your academic evaluation has been completed in order to determine which course work is remaining. Applicants and newly admitted students are encouraged to make an appointment with an advisor prior to registering for courses. To learn more about TESU courses, visit 【67†Course Registration】.
L160: 
L161:   * 【70†MyProgress Key to Abbreviations】
L162: The following list is to help you understand the abbreviations that may be seen on your degree program in MyProgress.
L163: CC - Community College Credit
L164:     Indicates that the course/credit is from a junior/ county/community college. A maximum of 90 junior or community college level credits can be applied toward a bachelor’s degree, and credits will be equated to 100/200 level course work.

L124:   * Academic Credit FAQs
L125:   * 【66†Math Readiness Practice Tests - Student FAQs】
L126: Thomas Edison State University offers a range of credit-earning opportunities designed specifically for adult learners. From 【23†transferring previously earned college credits】 to offering 【67†credit for military training】, we’ve created numerous programs that work around the unique needs of adults, enabling you to complete your degree.
L127: 
L128:   * 【68†Can I transfer my credits to Thomas Edison State University?】
L129: Yes. Actually, most of our students transfer their previously earned college credits to Thomas Edison State University to speed the completion of their degrees. 【46†Learn more】.
L130: 
L131:   * 【69†How do I earn credit for knowledge I’ve gained outside the classroom?】
L132: Our Prior Learning Assessment (PLA) offerings, including portfolio assessment, the TECEP exam program, credit for certain reviewed licenses, training, and certifications, and others give you the opportunity to demonstrate college-level knowledge you’ve acquired outside the classroom and apply that knowledge toward a degree program. Browse our 【70†PLA Course Description Database†www2.tesu.edu】 , list of 【71†available TECEP® tests†www2.tesu.edu】 and our list of 【72†Academic Program Reviews】.
L133:   * 【73†How many of my credits will you accept from other colleges or universities?】
L134:     * If you studied at an 【74†accepted institutionally accredited †tesu.smartcatalogiq.com】community college, you may apply up to 90 credits.
L135:     * If you studied at a regionally accredited four-year institution, you may fulfill all your degree requirements with transfer credit except the two required courses from TESU:
L136:       * SOS-110: Critical Information Literacy
L137:       * Capstone Course
L138:     * If you have studied at more than one institution, the University can accept your credits, provided the institutions are regionally accredited.
L139:   * 【75†Can I earn credit by “testing out” of a course?】
L140: 
L141: Yes. Our 【76†TECEP® program】 allows you to prepare for an exam that can earn you college credit. 【71†Browse list of available TECEP® tests†www2.tesu.edu】. In addition, numerous other exam programs can earn you credit.
L142: 
L143:   * 【77†Can I earn credit for my professional training, certification or licenses?】
L144: Yes.
L145: Thomas Edison State University will award credit for professional training and credentials evaluated and approved for credit by the University through our 【72†Office for Professional Learning Review】. The University may also accept credit recommendations for professional training and credentials from an institutional member of the Consortium for the Assessment of College Equivalency (CACE), the National College Credit Recommendation Service (National CCRS) of the Board of Regents of the University of the State of New York, and the American Council on Education's College Credit Recommendation Service (CREDIT) program.
L146:   * 【78†Can I earn credit for military training?】
L147: 
L148: Yes. For nearly three decades, we’ve been meeting the unique educational needs of military personnel. 【79†More about our Military Degree Completion Program】.
L149: 
L150:   * 【80†Can I earn credit for life experience at Thomas Edison State University?】
L151: Not exactly. Thomas Edison State University can grant you credit for knowledge you gained through life experience, but not for the experience itself. Students at the University can demonstrate that they possess college-level knowledge acquired outside the classroom through our 【81†Prior Learning Assessment programs】.
L152: 
L153:   * 【82†Do I need to take all my courses at Thomas Edison State University?】
L154: No. Our flexible 【46†credit transfer】 program enables students to complete courses at other regionally accredited institutions and then transfer those credits into your degree program at Thomas Edison State University.
L155: 
L156:   * 【83†Does TESU have any articulation agreements with any colleges or universities?】

L32: At the heart of UPI Study is the key to unlocking untapped potential and opening doors to boundless opportunities. Guided by our values of inclusivity, innovation, and impact, we proudly serve a diverse global community of learners who are eager to excel both academically and professionally. UPOI Study's curriculum is designed to be immersive, flexible, and deeply rooted in practical knowledge, equipping students to thrive in today's rapidly evolving industries.
L33: Recognized by the American Council on Education (ACE) and National College Credit Recommendation Service (NCCRS), UPI Study's courses are crafted to fit the demanding schedules of all students. UPI offers a wide array of essential general education subjects - spanning Mathematics, Science, Business, Health, and Social Sciences - preparing learners for continued studies or direct entry into degree programs at accredited institutions throughout the U.S.
L34: Since its founding, UPI Study has empowered thousands of students to advance their education, reduce their financial burden, and seize new opportunities. By prioritizing affordability and accessibility, UPI is transforming the landscape of higher education, ensuring that students from all walks of life can achieve their academic and professional dreams.
